rationale: FACTORY REVIEWER HALT_ACT_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH identified two defects in 4a4359bd5: (a) the execute_turn_prelude_enter capture was placed in LocalRuntimeHost.runTurn immediately before the await executeTurn(...) line, which only proves runTurn reached the call site — not that executeTurn entered; and (b) the PCRS02 suite synthesized stages via direct captureContinuationCardinalityAuthorityRecord calls and overclaimed PASS_OBSERVATION_SEAM without exercising the real host path. CORRECTION01 (a) MOVES the capture to the first executable line of LocalRuntimeHost.executeTurn (before the first await), which is the only placement that proves the prelude actually entered in JavaScript; (b) ADDS a real production-shape bridge test (PCRS02C01) that drives REAL LocalRuntimeHost.runTurn and proves the full C7 -> prelude -> C8 ring with the production capture helper wired through, asserts the STALL fingerprint (prelude fires, agent_turn_done absent when agent.run hangs), and ablations both with and without the prelude hook; (c) updates PCRS02-04/05 to be explicitly SHAPE-only and clearly defers the real-host proof to PCRS02C01.

correction_summary.boundary_moved_from: LocalRuntimeHost.runTurn — caller-side line immediately before await this.executeTurn(...) (proved only that runTurn reached the call site)
correction_summary.boundary_moved_to: LocalRuntimeHost.executeTurn — first executable line of the function body, BEFORE the first await at line ~2095 (const preparedInput = await this.prepareTurnInput(...))
correction_summary.rationale: In JavaScript, code before the first `await` inside an async function executes synchronously when that function is called. Therefore, the only placement that proves `executeTurn` actually entered is the first executable line of `executeTurn`, not its caller. The capture now fires SYNCHRONOUSLY at the synchronous entry of executeTurn, before the prelude awaits schedule.
correction_summary.threading_change: executeTurn's private input shape now optionally accepts `delivery?: 'queue' | 'steer'` and `jobId?: string` (both optional; defaults preserve existing callers in startSession). Threaded through runTurn's executeTurn call site so the prelude capture can derive origin the same way C7/C8 do. startSession-driven executeTurn calls pass undefined delivery/jobId, which is correct for that path.
